title.narrative: Strengthening member states’ capacities to devise and prioritize effective youth policies in EA

description.narrative: This workplan will strengthen member states’ capacities to devise and prioritize effective youth policies and interventions and to scale up youth-led solutions in East Asia. It will support youth engagement in various forms and create space for young people to express and voice their opinions. In Mongolia, UNESCO will support the annual model UNESCO Conference to provide a space to foster dialogues among youth, guiding them to understand international challenges, different thematic topics and formulate viable solutions. In China, UNESCO will continue the organization of the annual International Youth Forum on Creativity and Heritage along the Silk Roads, with a side project of IYF Silk Roads Cooperation Grants ongoing at the same time. Meanwhile, this workplan will support a new phase of YAR in collaboration with UNESCO Sites in the region, empowering grassroots youth to conduct researches. Also, Youth for Inclusive Cities will be supported by this workplan to conduct youth-led accessibility assessments and community-based research for creating a more inclusive urban space.
